summary.intent: Plan and execute phase 49 of cipher-box (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation ECIES unwrap consolidation, expanded mid-session to include batch and drag-move parity), then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security reviews, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and opening a PR.
summary.outcome: Planning completed (5 plans / 3 waves, 6 requirements, plan-checker passed after one revision round). All 5 plans executed with gates green (SDK 235 pass, web 51/51, tsc + lint clean). Simplify, security, and CodeRabbit CLI passes completed with 9 correctness/quality fixes applied. Branch is 30 commits ahead of main; PR push and post-PR CodeRabbit GitHub review resolution remain pending at transcript end.

repo: `reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange` (reencrypt.ts:49) is fully key-agnostic — takes raw key bytes, no owner-vs-recipient distinction — reusable verbatim for the shared-folder move path.

`share_keys` entries are keyed by `itemId` (file UUID), not by parent folder; the download path resolves `k.keyType === 'file' && k.itemId === item.id`, so file keys need no re-registration after an intra-share move.

`adoptSharedFolderResult` emits `sharedFolder:updated` with `live.ipnsName`; it must be called only once (for the source result) — calling it for the dest result corrupts the rendered shared-folder tree view.
`sdkCore.moveItem` throws `'An item with this name already exists in destination'` (sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts:346); collision policy is throw-and-surface, no auto-rename needed.
The `@internal` tag on `ensureFolderLoaded` is documentation-only; `CipherBoxClient` is already exported and can be called directly from web without a new public alias.

The `SharedFolderClient` Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) only listed the 7 Phase 48 methods; any new SDK client methods added to the shared-folder surface must be explicitly added to this allowlist.
File IPNS keys for re-encryption must come from `share_keys keyType:'file-ipns'`, not `FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` — the latter is owner-wrapped and recipients cannot decrypt it.

SDK `dist/` is gitignored; CI rebuilds it. Between waves when new public SDK methods are added that web imports, a manual `pnpm -F @cipher-box/sdk build` is required or web `tsc -b` will fail against stale declarations.
The web package has no `typecheck` npm script; the correct gate command is `tsc -b` run from the web package root.
The intel API surface file is empty (regex extractor unpopulated) — it is a HINT-only artifact; RESEARCH.md already carries all verified symbol refs and is the authoritative source for the planner.

`runWrite` in `useSharedWriteOps` calls `setError(null)` on entry to clear prior errors before attempting the operation — test assertions on `setError` must account for this initial null call on the success path.

Batch and drag-move for the shared view had zero implementation today; the private vault analogs (`useFileBrowserActions` selection Set → `handleBatchMoveConfirm`, `handleDragStart` multi-select-aware → `handleDropOnFolder`) are clean mirrors to follow.
`SelectionActionBar` required `onDownload` and `onDelete` props, causing the shared browser to stub them as no-ops — best fix is making those props optional and conditionally rendering the buttons.

code.finding: `enumerateSharedSubtree` DFS does not zero each per-iteration `folderKey` after decryption — plaintext AES folder keys remain live in heap across the full traversal. Fixed with try/finally zeroing on each iteration.

The refactored null-after-retries path built a degraded keyless `FolderNode` instead of erroring and redirecting (regression from Phase 48 behavior). CodeRabbit caught this; fixed by restoring the error + redirect branch.

`onMoveItemTo` closure checked the *drop target folder's* selection state to determine what to move, discarding the actual dragged payload. Fixed to resolve dragged items from `sortedChildren` by the ids forwarded from `SharedFolderRow`.

The drag handler did not forward which specific items were dragged (used selection state instead). Fixed to pass the dragged item ids explicitly, matching `FileListItem`'s multi-select-aware drag pattern.

Pick allowlist only covers Phase 48 methods; any new `SharedFolderClient` methods (e.g., `moveInSharedFolder`, `enumerateSharedSubtree`) must be explicitly added here or they are not callable from the web layer.

workflow: Sequential wave execution (no parallel worktrees) is the safer autonomous/AFK mode — the parallel-worktree merge-back protocol has known cwd-drift and merge-base footguns; sequential is a first-class supported path.

GSD plan-checker runs across 12 verification dimensions; the revision loop (re-spawn planner on blockers, re-run checker) converged in 1 iteration after fixing a missing unit-test gap and two RESEARCH.md doc nits.
/simplify is strictly quality-only (behavior-preserving); correctness bugs found during the simplify pass go in a dedicated correctness commit, not mixed into the simplify commit.

Two security review passes cover different surfaces: `security:review` (crypto-focused: ECIES, key zeroing, trust boundaries) and `security-review` (general appsec: input validation, authz, DoS, UI trust). Both should run for crypto-sensitive phases.
CodeRabbit CLI is run pre-PR (`coderabbit review --agent` scoped to merge-base); after PR creation CodeRabbit auto-posts a GitHub review and `/resolve-pr-reviews` addresses inline comments.
Batch + drag-move scope was added mid-planning (before the planner ran) — folding scope into ROADMAP.md + CONTEXT.md before spawning the planner avoids an expensive re-plan cycle.

When `commit.gpgsign` is disabled locally for an AFK run (to prevent 1Password signer from wedging), a signed rebase or admin override is needed before merge if the repo enforces signed commits on PRs.

The plan-checker's unit-test gap finding (REQ has no dedicated test → verify passes vacuously) is a high-value catch; check for existing test files before deciding to create new ones — extending an existing suite is cheaper.

friction: `gsd-tools` was not on PATH inside the planner-revision subagent — it could not commit its own artifacts, requiring a manual commit from the orchestrator after the revision returned.
Prettier reformatted `client.ts` during the security-fix commit, requiring a re-read of the file before the MEDIUM zeroing edit could be applied correctly.

CodeRabbit finding 2 (assert `setError` not called on success path) was a false positive — `runWrite` calls `setError(null)` on entry, so the assertion `not.toHaveBeenCalled()` incorrectly failed the test. Required investigation and revert.
A JSX comment placed inside a single-child conditional expression (`{cond && (...)}`) in SharedFileBrowser broke `tsc -b` — required a re-read and fix before tests could run.
Intel API surface file was empty (regex extractor unpopulated), making the HINT artifact useless for the planner; RESEARCH.md had to serve as the sole symbol-ref source.

RESEARCH.md had two doc formatting issues (missing resolution markers on open questions, wrong heading level) that caused plan-checker blockers — required direct edits before the revision round could proceed.
The initial concern about new SDK methods not appearing in `index.d.ts` (barrel re-export) sent unnecessary investigation time — methods were correctly in `client.d.ts` and visible to consumers.
open_items: PR push and creation are still pending (transcript ends before `git push` + `gh pr create` step).
CodeRabbit GitHub review resolution (`/resolve-pr-reviews`) is pending PR creation.
`useMultiSelect` extraction into a shared hook (reuse finding from /simplify) — deferred as cross-boundary scope creep beyond phase 49.
Batch key-refetch optimization in `batchMoveItemsHandler` (currently re-fetches `share_keys` per item) — accepted as v1 parity, deferred.
DFS concurrency in `enumerateSharedSubtree` (sequential by design to avoid gateway rate-limit amplification) — potential follow-up if subtrees become large.

Full SDK-layer enforcement of descendant/cycle guard — currently UI-guarded (SharedMoveDialog disables descendants) + SDK self-move-guarded; full server-side subtree check deferred since actor already holds write keys.
REQ-5 e2e tests require the live docker stack and local API — deferred to main-push gated UAT (same pattern as Phase 48).
`commit.gpgsign = false` local override needs to be re-enabled (`git config --local --unset commit.gpgsign`) before or after merge to restore global signing behavior.
`prunedCids` storage hygiene is pre-existing tech debt (not introduced by phase 49) — flagged in security review as a LOW recommendation.
